en: A black‑and‑white view of a quiet street in a European town, likely early 20th century. Two cyclists ride along a wide unpaved road lined with sidewalks and modest two‑ to three‑story houses with steep tiled roofs. On the left stands a more stately building with classical detailing and a gabled roof, partly obscured by a flowering tree and a metal fence. The right side shows houses set above the street behind a stone retaining wall with exterior staircases. In the far distance, the street narrows toward a cluster of gabled townhouses. The overall scene is calm and residential, with no motor vehicles visible.
